keyFindings.description: A session with no entry sent an unreadable mode: judgeFollowedTopic returns followedTopicModeUnreadable before the nil-target check, Resolve fails ErrNoSessionRecord, so relayed is false and the refusal records an attempt (recorded = !relayed). When the session registers again with its consumer start at or below the message, its relay judges followedTopicAttempted and holds for attemptCacheTTL (5 min), stalling later messages, then reports a second delivery_failed. Contradicts delivery.go:999-1003, AGENTS.md:3411 and the changelog. fanout_refusal_reports_test.go:81 pins wantAttempt: true. Test that must fail: serving-port consumer session, delete its entry, publish {"delivery":{"mode":"bogus"}}, await the fan-out, assert no attempt record; register again and assert a later message reaches the port well inside attemptCacheTTL. Fix: recorded = err == nil && !delivery.Relayed.
Structure: decide refusals before the take case (relayed && Port > 0 skip; else report with recorded) so the 'verdict == take ||' clause and the three copies of the reason go.

compare_issue_order's length check cannot fail: published_order and written_order come from the same filter; read the markers once and sort by stream_seq; the duplicated selector is checked in one copy only.

The comment 'nothing reads such a record back for that session' is wrong (judgeFollowedTopic reads it on the next copy, which is why a portless relayed session now gets one exception per copy and redelivery); name the serving-port hold as the reason. session_relay_portless_refusal_test.go duplicates a row of fanout_refusal_reports_test.go.
